verdicts.reason: A: the RSVP CTA has been shrunk into a tiny pill the same size as the FREE ENTRY/ALL AGES/TASTINGS badges, which buries it in the bottom-left corner. The top text block is jammed together with almost no leading, mixes centred lines (tagline, URL) with left-aligned ones (date, time), and the 'SOLSTICE PRESENTS' eyebrow now sits below the headline it should introduce. B: it has the same broken reading order and the same mixed left/centre alignment in the text stack, and a large grey placeholder box with cramped legal text spoils the bottom-left. However, its RSVP button is at least larger than the badges, the badges sit in one even row, and the upper text has more breathing room, so it is slightly less broken.
